description: MN MATOC FY28 Category � Y Construction of structures and Facilities Date Published: 17 Nov 2026 Contract: Drue Glaze at the the Minnesota USPFO 15000 Hwy 115 Bldg 15-2 Camp Ripley, Little Falls MN 56345. Phone Number 320.616.2752 Synopsis: MN MATOC FY28 This is a Sources Sought Synopsis for the purpose of conducting market research, and obtaining industry information ONLY. No proposals are being requested, nor accepted at this time. The purpose of this synopsis is to gain knowledge of interest, capabilities and qualifications of small business concerns, including 8(a), Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone), Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB), and Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB). The USPFO for Minnesota will use this information to develop an acquisition strategy for the upcoming Construction Indefinite Delivery-Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Task Order Contracts (MATOC) for maintenance, repair, and construction in Minneapolis/St. Paul (Twin Cities) and Duluth, MN. Typical work includes, but is not be limited to: interior and exterior renovations, heating and air-conditioning, HVAC controls, plumbing, fire suppression, interior and exterior electrical and lighting, fire and intrusion alarms, communications, limited utilities, site-work, landscaping, fencing, masonry, roofing, concrete, asphalt paving, storm drainage, limited environmental remediation, construction of new facilities and other related work. All will be in accordance with individual task order requirements, specifications and drawings provided with each project and/or master specifications. Prospective contractors must be able to react within 120 minutes (2 hours) in response to emergencies via the main office or a staffed satellite office. The Government anticipates award of a maximum of nine (9) individual MATOC contracts and provided sufficient qualified contractors respond. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS), code(s) for the MATOCs will be 236220. The small business size standard will be $45 million average annual revenue for the previous three years. Total contract period for each MATOC shall not exceed five (5) calendar years. Delivery Orders will range in value from $2,500.00 to $5,000,000.00. The total of individual task orders placed against a MATOC shall not exceed $49,000,000.00 to any one contractor. Source Selection procedures will be utilized to determine awardees. All interested small business concerns will provide this office with the following: (1) A statement of positive intent to submit a proposal for a MATOC; (2) Company Name, address, point of contact, telephone number, and email address; (3) Small Business status, to include 8a, HUBZone, SBD, SDVOSB, large / small business etc. Status of 8(a) or HUBZone contractors will be verified by the Small Business Administration (SBA); (4) Provide a general statement of your qualifications, capabilities and demonstrate the capacity to perform this type of work; (5) Demonstrate experience and technical competence in the execution of construction projects, in the dollar value range of $2,000.00 to $5,000,000.00. Provide a brief description of projects / work performed, contract number, total contract value, and period of performance; (6) A brief outline of resources, subcontractors, and key personnel that would be used to accomplish the task orders; (7) Indicate which locations you will submit a proposal for Minneapolis/St. Paul, Duluth or both. (8) Provide a list of up to 3 projects that you have done that are similar in scope. In the event sufficient small business contractors are not available for adequate competition for this MATOC, it will be advertised as unrestricted. Submissions shall not exceed 5 typewritten pages and will be sent via email to drue.l.glaz.mil@army.mil and luke.d.thomsen.civ@army.mil by the closing date posted in SAM. Include the following in the subject line �Sources Sought W912LM-28-R-1000 MN MATOC�.

title: Port Everglades USCG Reconfiguration Project
description: UPDATED 17 NOVEMBER 2026 UPDATED NOTICE ID #: W912EP27Z1CW1 ************************************************************************************************************************************************ This announcement constitutes a Source Sought Synopsis. This announcement seeks information from industry and will only be used for preliminary planning purposes. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR BIDS AND NO CONTRACT SHALL BE AWARDED FROM THIS SYNOPSIS. Respondents will not be notified of the results of the evaluation. The Jacksonville District of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers is seeking interest from prospective bidders for a potential fiscal year (FY) 2027 award of a contract for this construction project. The purpose of this sources sought is to gauge interest, capabilities, and qualifications of contractors that have design-build experience in completing similar projects. The proposed project will be a Firm Fixed Price (FFP) contract. The Jacksonville District anticipates the issuance of a Request for Proposal (RFP). No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this sources sought or any follow-up information requested. DESCRIPTION OF WORK: The US Coast Guard (USCG) Station Fort Lauderdale Reconfiguration project includes the abatement and demolition of the existing USCG facilities, including all pile foundations, sheet pile bulkheads, and other incidental work to clear site for construction. Work includes excavation, dredging, removal, re-positioning, and disposal of existing soils. Some of the soil contains fuel or paving-based contamination and therefore, must be removed off-site in accordance with state and federal laws and regulations. Construct a new three-story multi-mission facility approximately 36,000 gross square feet (gsf), a separate 1-story boathouse of approximately 5,000 gsf, a 17-foot by 20-foot outdoor covered area at the armory entrance, and a 30-foot by 50-foot outdoor covered cross fit area. Construct a boat basin that includes steel sheet pile sea wall, bulkhead walls, and a covered boat mooring area with floating boat slips. Prior to demolition of the existing USCG Station Fort Lauderdale, provide a new provisional turnkey facility. The provisional facility will be located at Port Everglades Berth 28. The provisional facility includes six turnkey, complete, and pre-engineered relocatable buildings units (RLB's). Contract drawings are provided by the government to place RLB's and USCG boat houses on Port Everglades property. RLB's are designed and engineered by the manufacturer and installed by the contractor. Provide non-personnel commercial moving services to relocate the existing station into the new provisional station in addition to utility connections, furnishes and other items, and services. Provide maintenance at the provisional station within the stipulated period of performance. Once the USCG Station Fort Lauderdale Reconfiguration project is completed, provide moving services to return the USCG to the new permanent station. Once the permanent station is completed and accepted, the USCG has been relocated to the new site, remove all provisional facilities and site features. Restore the site to pre-construction conditions. ROUGH ORDER OF MAGNITUDE: Between $100,000,000 and $250,000,000 PRODUCT SERVICE CODE: Y1AZ � Construction of Other Administrative Facilities and Service Buildings NAICS CODE: The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this procurement is 236220 � Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. SMALL BUSINESS SIZE STANDARD: $45,000,000 SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS: Responses to this Sources Sought shall be limited to 5 pages and shall include the following information: Company/Contractor name, address, point of contact, phone number and e-mail address. Company�s interest in bidding on the subject requirement when issued. Company�s capability to perform a contract of this magnitude and complexity (include company�s capability to execute comparable work performed within the past 3 years). Company should provide at least 3 examples which, at a minimum, include the following: (a) Brief description of the project (b) Customer Name (c) Customer Satisfaction (d) Timeliness of Performance (e) Dollar value of the completed projects. Offeror shall identify their Small Business classification and Small Business Size: (a) Small Business (b) Small Disadvantage Business (c) 8(a) Small Business (d) HUBZone (e) SDVOSB (f) WOSB. If significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated in order to deliver technical capability, firms should address the structure of such arrangement include Joint Venture information, if applicable � existing and potential. Bonding Capacity (construction bonding level per contract and aggregate construction bonding level, both expressed in dollars) via letter from the bonding company. NOTES: DO NOT SUBMIT A RESPONSE TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IF YOU DO NOT INTEND TO BID ON THIS PROJECT. DO NOT SUBMIT PROPRIETARY AND/OR BUSINESS CONFIDENITAL DATA. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: Interested parties who consider themselves qualified to perform the work associated with the subject requirement, are invited to submit a response to this Sources Sought Notice no later than December 17,2026, at 2:00 PM, EDT. All responses under this Sources Sought Notice shall be sent to Ireishal Adams at Ireishal.C.Adams@usace.army.mil. Prior Government contract work is not required for submitting a response under this sources sought synopsis. You must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM), in order to be eligible to receive an award from any Government solicitation. To register, go to www.sam.gov. For additional information visit the website for the Federal Service Desk (www.FSD.gov) which supports SAM or contact them at 866-606-8220 for assistance.

title: Repair of NSN: 3010016608071FD Gearcase Motor, JTE System
description: Repair of NSN: 3010016608071FD Gearcase Motor for the Joint Threat Emitter (JTE) System SCOPE OF WORK: For the end item, the contractor shall furnish all facilities, parts, materials, equipment and services, required to inspect and, if necessary, restore to serviceable condition. Services to be performed will not be essential in a crisis situation. Work consists of one of two efforts: Test, teardown, and evaluation (TT&E) only or TT&E and repair. TEST, TEARDOWN, AND EVALUATION: The contractor shall perform visual, mechanical and electrical testing of the end item, reusable or replacement component parts, and materials according to the schedule in the contract to determine the condition of the end item. Upon completion of this task, all of the components of the end item requiring repair or replacement will be identified by part number, NSN (if applicable), nomenclature, and location in the assembly. This information will be reported in writing to the Procurement Contracting Officer (PCO)/ Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA) Administrative Contracting Officer (ACO) and, if necessary, approval to repair will be negotiated. If no further repair is required, the asset must be returned in serviceable condition and meet section 6.0 cosmetic requirements. REPAIR: (NTE) The contractor shall perform the repair or replacement of all failed parts and components. Each end item must be cleaned, configured, refinished, and tested to meet the original specifications of the end item. The end item shall be returned in serviceable condition and meet section 6.0 cosmetic requirements. Item Description: GEARCASE-MOTOR NSN: 3010-01-660-8071 Part Number: 133610-5 Quantity: 6 The attached This Determination and Findings (D&F) authorizes solicitation from a single source, Linmarr Associates, Inc. (CAGE: 1GX03), for the acquisition of the repair of One (6) each of NSN: 3130-01-660-8071, Gearcase-Motor for the Joint Threat Emitter (JTE). This action will be conducted using the procedures set forth in Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Part 13, Simplified Acquisition Procedures.The authority for this action is RFO 13.101(b), which permits soliciting from a single source if the Contracting Officer determines that the circumstances of the contract action deem only one source reasonably available. The contractor performing these services is Linmarr Associates, Inc. (CAGE: 1GX03), the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of these items, own the complete technical data package and data rights. Linmarr Associates, Inc. (CAGE: 1GX03) has the necessary facilities and processes in place to repair the Gearcase Motors.

title: J041--RFQ-SDVOSB-Metasys Building Automation System Johnson Controls Services
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with FAR Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are being requested, and a separate solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for Metasys Building Automation System (BAS) Controls Services for the Michael E. DeBakey VA Medical Center (MEDVAMC), Houston, Texas. The requirement consists of providing all labor, supervision, OEM-authorized technical support, tools, software, transportation, training, and management necessary to perform operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, programming, calibration, optimization, database management, reporting, and support services for the Government-owned Johnson Controls Metasys Building Automation System and associated HVAC Building Service Equipment. This acquisition is being conducted as a 100 percent Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside under NAICS 238220, Plumbing, Heating, and Air-Conditioning Contractors. The principal purpose of this acquisition is the provision of commercial building automation system (BAS) and HVAC controls operations, maintenance, troubleshooting, programming, optimization, repair, calibration, reporting, training, and technical support services for an existing Government-owned Johnson Controls Metasys Building Automation System and associated Building Service Equipment. Although classified under NAICS 238220, this acquisition is being solicited and administered as a commercial services contract and is not a construction contract. This acquisition does not limit competition to Johnson Controls as the prime contractor. Competition is permitted among eligible SDVOSBs capable of providing the required services, including through documented arrangements for necessary OEM support, software access, training verification, and compatible parts. title: RFI - Commercial Alternatives for GOES Rebroadcast (GRB) and High-Rate Information Transmission (HRIT) / Emergency Managers� Warning Information Network (EMWIN) Services
description: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) is seeking information from commercial industry partners regarding the feasibility, technical approach, and cost-effectiveness of replacing the current GOES Rebroadcast (GRB) system and the GOES High-Rate Information Transmission / Emergency Managers� Warning Information Network (HRIT/EMWIN) broadcast with a commercially provided service or services. The primary objective of this RFI is to identify market capabilities for the dissemination of data currently broadcast by the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellites (GOES) hemispherical L-band GRB and HRIT/EMWIN broadcasts. The intent is to move away from government-owned and operated RF broadcast infrastructure toward a "Data-as-a-Service" model. This strategy aligns with NOAA's broader planning for future geostationary environmental observations under the Geostationary Extended Observations (GeoXO) program, which establishes a clear path to transition from government satellite-hosted distribution to commercial-based services for GRB and HRIT/EMWIN in the 2032 timeframe. Under this new operational architecture, selected products will be passed from the cloud to commercial providers to be uplinked to commercial communications satellites, ensuring the direct readout community retains robust access over radio frequency (RF) links.

title: Jäteastioiden ja -säiliöiden pesupalvelut 2027
description: Pirkanmaan Jätehuolto Oy pyytää tarjouksia toimialueensa kiinteistöillä sijaitsevien jäteastioiden 140-770 l sekä säiliöiden 0,3-5 m3 pesupalvelusta. Pirkanmaan Jätehuolto järjestää alueensa kiinteistöille vuosittain pesukampanjoita, jolloin kiinteistön keräysvälineet pestään kertapesuna. Kampanjoita on vuodessa jäteastioille kaksi (kevät ja syksy) ja säiliöille kolme (kevät, kesä ja syksy). Pesu koskee vain niiden kiinteistöjen keräysvälineitä, jotka ilmoittautuvat mukaan pesukierrokselle. Perusurakkakausi on 1.4.2027 – 31.3.2029 (2 vuotta), jonka jatkoksi tilaajan ja urakoitsijan on mahdollisuus sopia yhden (1) vuoden optiosopimuksesta., Osa-alue1: Jäteastioiden 140-770 l pesu Kaksi kertaa vuodessa toteutettava pesukampanja (kevät ja syksy). Pestävät jäteastiat ovat pääsääntöisesti 660 litran kannellisia jäteastioita, mutta mukana on myös 140, 240, 360 ja 770 l:n astioita., Osa-alue 2: Säiliöiden pesu 0,3-5 m3 Kolme kertaa vuodessa toteutettava pesukampanja (kevät, kesä ja syksy). Pestävät syväsäiliöt ja nostoperusteiset pintasäiliöt ovat eri valmistajien tekemiä, mutta käytössä olevaan jätteiden keräysjärjestelmään (nosturin avulla tyhjennettävät keräyssäiliöt) sopivia.,

title: Total Ship Training Capability (TSTC) - Request for Information and Draft RFP
description: The purpose of this announcement is: (1) to conduct market research via a Request for Information (RFI), and (2) to obtain industry feedback on the accompanying Draft Request for Proposal (RFP). This announcement is in support of the Navy�s Total Ship Training Capability (TSTC) program issued by the Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) for Mission Systems, Program Manager Warfare (PMW) 610F. The Government is seeking sources capable of producing build-to-print mature training systems and providing associated engineering, warehousing, and lifecycle efforts in direct support of the production of these systems. The potential ordering period is Fiscal Year 2028 through 2033. This RFI and Draft RFP are for informational and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation or Request for Proposal (RFP). Responses may be reviewed by Government personnel and authorized support service contractors. By submitting a response, the respondent consents to the disclosure of its information to such support contractors for the purpose of review and analysis. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The Government will not reimburse any costs associated with responding to this notice. Information submitted will become the property of the United States Government. This announcement is a follow-on to the TSTC Industry Day notice previously posted on SAM.gov. The prior notice can be viewed here: https://sam.gov/workspace/contract/opp/d1dd449cfe744bb2ba0702c445bfbf37/view TDP ACCESS INSTRUCTIONS Technical Data Packages (TDPs) for the production items are available to eligible U.S. DoD contractors. The TDPs are marked Distribution Statement D and may contain export-controlled information. To request access, interested parties must email the following documents to the RFI Points of Contact: A fully executed Attachment 1 � Terms of Use Agreement (TOUA) signed by an authorized company representative; and A valid, approved DD Form 2345 demonstrating active registration in the Joint Certification Program (JCP). Upon receipt and verification of these documents, the Government will grant access at its sole discretion. Only U.S. companies with an active Joint Certification Program (JCP) certification are eligible to receive the TDP. DRAFT RFP FEEDBACK INSTRUCTIONS The Draft RFP is provided as Attachment 2 � TSTC RFP Draft (Microsoft Word format). description: KC-135 gearbox is a critical component, it is used to operate the wing flaps, there are multiple gearboxes used for various reasons, most notably the Emergency Flap Drive Gearbox assembly, which operates the wing flaps in the event that the main hydraulic system fails.

title: HI FLAP CR562(1) Kilauea Point
description: Kilauea Point National Wildlife Refuge (KPNWR) is a 203-acre facility located on the north shore of the Island of Kaua'i. It is part of the Kaua'i National Wildlife Refuge Complex managed by the United States Fish and Wildlife Service. To keep up with the visitation demands, the KPNWR and the USFWS along with the Federal Highway Administration Central Federal Lands Highway Division is proposing to improve the area by providing better access along Kolo Road and Kilauea Road (Route 562) for pedestrians and bicyclists, as well as improvements to the overlook. The project consists of installation of a sidewalk adjacent the existing roadway from the intersection of Kuhio Highway to the KPNWR Overlook. Work includes pavement rehabilitation and resurfacing of the existing roadway, with full depth pavement on aggregate base course for roadway widening segments, and reconstruction of the existing turnaround. Guardrail, sidewalk, curb, gutter, two mini-roundabouts, striping, and pedestrian crossings will be provided to establish a safe and accessible corridor for pedestrians and bicyclists. Minor utility adjustments and construction is also anticipated. The total project length is approximately 1.70 miles.

title: Hälytysvalvonta- ja piirivartiointipalvelu 2027-2031 (2033)
description: Hälytysvalvonta- ja piirivartiointipalvelu 2027-2031 (2033) Lahden kaupunki pyytää osallistumishakemuksia Hälytysvalvonta- ja piirivartiointipalvelujen hankintaan. Hankinnan kohteena ovat Lahden kaupungin ja Koulutuskeskus Salpauksen tarvitsemat vartiointipalvelut. Hankintaan sisältyy erilaisia vartiointi- ja turvallisuuspalveluja tilaajien tarpeiden mukaisesti. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö, palveluille asetettavat vaatimukset sekä palvelukohteet kuvataan varsinaisen tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden yhteydessä. Hankinnan arvioitu kokonaisarvo on (sopimuskausi 4 vuotta, mahdollinen optiokausi 2 vuotta) noin 3 500 000 €. Hankinta toteutetaan kaksivaiheisena menettelynä. Ensimmäisessä vaiheessa ehdokkaat jättävät osallistumishakemuksensa. Osallistumishakemusten perusteella hankintayksikkö valitsee enintään neljä (4) ehdokasta, jotka kutsutaan menettelyn toiseen vaiheeseen jättämään tarjous. Ehdokkaiden tulee täyttää osallistumispyynnössä asetetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset. Mikäli soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttäviä ehdokkaita on enemmän kuin neljä (4), tarjousvaiheeseen kutsuttavat ehdokkaat valitaan osallistumispyynnössä ilmoitettujen vertailuperusteiden mukaisesti.,

On Ocotber 30, 2026, Amendment No. 3 was issued to provide responses to questioins received from prospective offerors, provide as-built drawing and photos for reference only, extend thequestions due date to December 1, 2026, and to extend the proposal due date to December 17, 2026. On October 7, 2026, Amendment No. 2 was issued to correct badge access link provided in Amendment No. 1. On October 6, 2026, Amendment No. 1 was issued to provide dates for site visits. This scope of work is to build an addition and renovate the Central Utility Building (CUB). The CUB supplies chilled water, hot water, low conductivity water, and makeup water to various lab buildings and systems. These systems serve both comfort cooling and heating needs, as well as process cooling and utility requirements. It is vital to Fermilab�s mission that CUB be revitalized and expanded, ensuring the ability to serve existing and future loads. The General contractor shall furnish all required supervision, labor, materials, tools, plant and appurtenances necessary to perform diligently and fully all work as described in the drawings and technical specifications. All work includes transportation, overhead, bonding costs, safety oversight, quality control oversight, and supervision as required to construct the project described in the drawings, technical specification and the detailed description contained herein. The critical schedule constraint for construction of this project is Fermilab�s accelerator shutdown, with an anticipated scheduled start on January 1, 2028, and anticipated end date of January 1, 2030- these dates may change depending on the needs of the Lab. The General Contractor must start their on-site efforts, and complete the construction scope under this contract, within the shutdown window. This project includes the following milestones: Milestone 1 � Issuance of Notice to Proceed (NTP) to 30th December 2027. This milestone is intended for completion of necessary submittals and RFIs, approval of shop drawings for fabrication and procurement. Milestone 2 � 3rd January 2028; This milestone marks the point where construction work may begin. Milestone 3 � 31st January 2029; AUP 1 CUB Extension complete. Milestone 4 � 29th June 2029; AUP 2 Existing CUB Upgrade complete. Milestone 5 � 28th September 2029; Completion of CUB- including all remedial work following removal of site trailers.

title: WS FIXED WING FLIGHT SERVICES
description: The required tasks and responsibilities of the Contractor providing fixed-wing flight services in support of the North Dakota WS Programs. Contracted flight operations primarily support activities related to wildlife damage management. Additional missions may include disease monitoring, removal of invasive species, and emergency response operations. Flight requirements may fluctuate based on predation levels, operational priorities, and weather conditions; however, the Contractor must remain available to perform services with a minimum of 72 hours notice. WS may conduct operations under interagency agreements or cooperative service agreements with state and federal agencies, and private landowners. The Contractors services may be utilized to support any such agreements. The government is awarding a firm, fixed-price, indefinite delivery, indefinite quantity, commercial services contract. The period of performance for this contract includes five ordering periods and each ordering period will be twelve (12) months in duration.
